tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find Liro React + Tailwind components by what they do. Returns the best matches first with slug, category, access (free or pro) and version. Start here, then call get_component for details.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Everything about one component except its source: when to use it, props, variants, npm dependencies, the files it installs, a typechecked usage example with real props, how it sizes and scrolls (layout), the components it pairs with and the recipes it appears in.

tools.name: get_component_code
tools.description: The complete source for one component and every file it imports, ready to save at the paths given. Free components need a free Liro account's token; Pro components need the caller's Liro lifetime access. Install with the shadcn CLI instead when you can run commands (see get_installation).

tools.name: get_installation
tools.description: Installation for one or more components: the one-time @liro registry setup for components.json, the shadcn CLI command (always @liro/<slug>, never a bare URL), a ready-to-run agent command with a 15-minute install token when this connection carries a CLI token, the npm packages still missing (pass i

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories in the Liro catalogue with the components in each, plus the library contract: stack, theme, access, install path, and the accessibility and responsive behaviour every component has.

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Find complete Liro React / Next.js templates: what each is, its stack, a live preview and how it is licensed.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: One template's details and whether the caller may download it. Never returns the template's files.

tools.name: check_access
tools.description: Whether the caller can take a component or template, and why: free, subscriber, lifetime, purchased or unauthorized.

tools.name: get_theme
tools.description: The theme's colour tokens (light and dark values, and what each one colours), how to restyle Liro to a brand from your own CSS without editing components, the type scale, and the cn() config for it.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Complete, runnable files that combine several Liro components the way they fit together: an AI chat app shell (Sidebar + Conversation History + AI Chat, with a phone drawer), a dashboard app and a billing page. Without a slug, lists the recipes. Every recipe typechecks against the components.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_installation" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
